name: claude-code-knowledge
description: Lookup skill plus harness-optimized reference files for authoring and configuring Claude Code — skills, subagents, hooks, slash commands, MCP, plugins, CLAUDE.md memory, and settings — a read-only expert agent that replaces the built-in claude-code-guide, a cc-review skill that audits components, a cc-author skill that creates new components, and a memory-audit skill that audits & improves a project's memory (every CLAUDE.md and .claude/rules/*.md by default) with a claude-md-improver-style quality report and leanness/scope-split recommendations (automatically with --fix, or via an AskUserQuestion multi-select), all grounded in the same cc-reference knowledge, and a cc-compress skill that compresses a markdown memory file into dense caveman-style prose to cut future-session load tokens, backing up the original to session-temp storage for rollback, and an lsp-audit skill that audits a project's file extensions against the .lsp.json of its project-scope lsp plugin (.claude/skills/lsp/, migrating and removing a legacy project-root .lsp.json) and additively adds the missing LSP server entries a bundled catalog recognizes (automatically with --fix, or via an AskUserQuestion multi-select), and a repository-audit skill that runs a full repository audit end to end — flagging whether the baseline memory files (a root CLAUDE.md and a .claude/rules/ directory) exist, then running lsp-audit and memory-audit in sequence (forwarding --fix and the repo path), offering the manual to-dos memory-audit returns (leanness trims, scope-split moves) for selection via AskUserQuestion (all applied automatically with --fix), then detecting the repository's development tools (runtimes, package managers, LSP servers) and offering — or with --fix creating — a project-level init-dev-environment skill that installs them at user level into ~/.local/bin, and folding all four passes into one combined report. Retrieves only the relevant section into context. (CC docs read: 2026-09-18)
